LESSON: CONSUMER SATISFACTION

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: BUSINESS STUDIES
Strand: Business and Its Environment
Topic 2.6: consumer Satisfaction
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers consumer Satisfaction, part of Business and Its Environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 BUSINESS STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is consumer satisfaction important in business?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on consumer Satisfaction together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: learner develops effective communication skills when sharing the findings in class on the survey

regarding customer satisfaction on products offered by the school community.

● Critical thinking and problem solving: learner enhances research skills when carrying out the customer survey.

● Creativity and imagination: learner strengthens networking skills when role playing on remedies for consumer

satisfaction.

● Digital literacy: learner develops skills of interacting and connecting with digital device with assistive technology

when searching for information on the terms and conditions in supply of good and services.

Values:
● Unity: learner cooperates with others when preparing a questionnaire to collect data on consumer satisfaction with

regard to the products offered in the community and share the findings in class.

● Love: learner respects others when sharing experiences on cases involving consumer satisfaction remedies for a

product.

● Respect: learner accepts diverse opinions when discussing and presenting on the meaning and importance of

consumer satisfaction in business.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Peer Education and Mentorship: learner enhances interpersonal relationships when discussing and presenting on

the meaning and importance of consumer satisfaction in business.

● Financial Literacy: learner enhances consumer literacy skills when sharing experiences on cases involving

customer satisfaction.

● Internet Safety and Security: responsible online behaviour is enhanced as learner uses digital devices with assistive

technology to search for information on terms and conditions in supply of good and services.

Suggested Key Skill(s)

● Analysing types of economic resources in satisfaction of human needs and wants.

● Investigating the importance of business activities in society.

● Examining formation, management, sources of finance, advantages, and disadvantages of a partnership business

enterprise in Kenya.

● Identifying an opportunity and starting a business in school.

● Analysing the concept of the division of labour and specialization in production.

● Designing an appropriate label for a product in print or tactile formats.

• Carrying out a customer satisfaction survey for improvement of service delivery.
